title: ononis repens subsp. procurrens
intro: Ononis repens subsp. procurrens, commonly known as creeping restharrow, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family. It is a low-growing, spreading plant with a long history of traditional use in medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of creeping restharrow include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and protection against oxidative stress. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-inflammatory effects, and scavenge free radicals.
